             \\\n            fprintf(stderr, \"MPI error %d at %s:%d\\n\", err__, __FILE__,         \\\n                    __LINE__);                                                  \\\n            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);                                       \\\n        }                                                                       \\\n    } while (0)\n\n// Generate synthetic 2D point data in clusters\nvoid generateSyntheticData(std::vector<Point>& points, const int N, unsigned int seed = 42) {\n    auto frand = [&seed]() mutable { return rand_r(&seed) / static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX); };\n\n    const double min_dim = std::min(MAX_WIDTH, MAX_HEIGHT);\n    int count = 0;\n\n    while (count < N) {\n        // Create group_cnt points within a circle of radius R\n        // around center point (cntr_x, cntr_y)\n        const double cntr_x = frand() * MAX_WIDTH;\n        const double cntr_y = frand() * MAX_HEIGHT;\n        const double R = frand() * min_dim / 2.0;\n        int group_cnt = static_cast<int>(frand() * (N / 30.0));\n\n        // Make sure we don't make more points than we need\n        if (group_cnt > (N - count)) {\n            group_cnt = N - count;\n        }\n\n        while (group_cnt > 0) {\n            const double sign = (frand() < 0.5) ? -1.0 : 1.0;\n            const double r = frand() * R;\n            const double dx = (2.0 * frand() - 1.0) * r;\n            const double dy = std::sqrt(r * r - dx * dx) * sign;\n            const double x = cntr_x + dx;\n            const double y = cntr_y + dy;\n\n            if (x < 0 || x > MAX_WIDTH || y < 0 || y > MAX_HEIGHT) {\n                continue;\n            }\n\n            points[count] = {x, y};\n            count++;\n            group_cnt--;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Calculate Euclidean distance between two points.\n// Host and device variants use explicitly non-fused arithmetic so that both\n// produce the identical IEEE-754 result.\ninline double distance(const Point& p1, const Point& p2) {\n    double dx = p1.x - p2.x;\n    double dy = p1.y - p2.y;\n    return std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);\n}\n\n__device__ __forceinline__ double dev_distance(double x1, double y1, double x2, double y2) {\n    const double dx = x1 - x2;\n    const double dy = y1 - y2;\n    return sqrt(__dadd_rn(__dmul_rn(dx, dx), __dmul_rn(dy, dy)));\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// CUDA kernel: grow one candidate cluster per thread block\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\nstatic const int QT_BLOCK = 256;\n\n// Block-wide arg-min over (distance, index) pairs; ties resolved by smaller index.\n__device__ __forceinline__ void warp_argmin(double& d, int& i) {\n#pragma unroll\n    for (int off = 16; off > 0; off >>= 1) {\n        const double od = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, d, off);\n        const int oi = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, i, off);\n        if (od < d || (od == d && oi < i)) {\n            d = od;\n            i = oi;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n__global__ void __launch_bounds__(QT_BLOCK)\nqt_candidate_kernel(const double* __restrict__ px,\n                    const double* __restrict__ py,\n                    const int* __restrict__ unclustered,   // candidate set (U entries)\n                    const int U,\n                    const int* __restrict__ seeds,         // seeds to evaluate\n                    const int nseeds,\n                    const double threshold,\n                    int* __restrict__ work_counter,        // dynamic seed scheduling\n                    int* __restrict__ cardinality_out,     // per seed\n                    int* __restrict__ scratch_idx,         // gridDim.x * U\n                    double* __restrict__ scratch_d,        // gridDim.x * U\n                    int* __restrict__ members_out)         // optional (nseeds == 1)\n{\n    __shared__ int s_task;\n    __shared__ double s_red_d[QT_BLOCK / 32];\n    __shared__ int s_red_i[QT_BLOCK / 32];\n    __shared__ int s_best;\n\n    const int tid = threadIdx.x;\n    const int lane = tid & 31;\n    const int warp = tid >> 5;\n    const int B = blockDim.x;\n\n    int* my_idx = scratch_idx + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * U;\n    double* my_d = scratch_d + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * U;\n\n    for (;;) {\n        if (tid == 0) s_task = atomicAdd(work_counter, 1);\n        __syncthreads();\n        const int task = s_task;\n        if (task >= nseeds) break;\n\n        const int seed = seeds[task];\n        const double sx = px[seed];\n        const double sy = py[seed];\n\n        // Initialise: every candidate c != seed with dist(seed, c) < threshold.\n        // Candidates at distance >= threshold can never be added since the\n        // diameter only grows.  Thread t owns slots t, t+B, t+2B, ...\n        int cnt = 0;\n        for (int j = tid; j < U; j += B) {\n            const int c = unclustered[j];\n            if (c == seed) continue;\n            const double d = dev_distance(sx, sy, px[c], py[c]);\n            if (d < threshold) {\n                my_idx[tid + cnt * B] = c;\n                my_d[tid + cnt * B] = d;\n                ++cnt;\n            }\n        }\n\n        int size = 1;\n        if (members_out != nullptr && tid == 0) members_out[0] = seed;\n\n        for (;;) {\n            // Local arg-min over the thread's candidates.\n            double bd = INFINITY;\n            int bi = INT_MAX;\n            for (int j = 0; j < cnt; ++j) {\n                const double d = my_d[tid + j * B];\n                const int i = my_idx[tid + j * B];\n                if (d < bd || (d == bd && i < bi)) {\n                    bd = d;\n                    bi = i;\n                }\n            }\n            warp_argmin(bd, bi);\n            if (lane == 0) {\n                s_red_d[warp] = bd;\n                s_red_i[warp] = bi;\n            }\n            __syncthreads();\n            if (warp == 0) {\n                const int nwarps = B >> 5;\n                bd = (lane < nwarps) ? s_red_d[lane] : INFINITY;\n                bi = (lane < nwarps) ? s_red_i[lane] : INT_MAX;\n                warp_argmin(bd, bi);\n                if (lane == 0) s_best = bi;\n            }\n            __syncthreads();\n            const int best = s_best;\n            if (best == INT_MAX) break;   // no candidate keeps diameter < threshold\n\n            if (members_out != nullptr && tid == 0) members_out[size] = best;\n            ++size;\n\n            // Update incremental diameters with the new member and compact\n            // away candidates that are now out of range (or the new member).\n            const double mx = px[best];\n            const double my = py[best];\n            int w = 0;\n            for (int j = 0; j < cnt; ++j) {\n                const int i = my_idx[tid + j * B];\n                if (i == best) continue;\n                double d = my_d[tid + j * B];\n                const double dm = dev_distance(mx, my, px[i], py[i]);\n                d = (dm > d) ? dm : d;\n                if (d < threshold) {\n                    my_idx[tid + w * B] = i;\n                    my_d[tid + w * B] = d;\n                    ++w;\n                }\n            }\n            cnt = w;\n            // s_best / s_red_* are rewritten only after the next\n            // __syncthreads() in the reduction, so no extra barrier needed.\n        }\n\n        if (tid == 0) cardinality_out[task] = size;\n        __syncthreads();   // protect s_task before the next task fetch\n    }\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Per-GPU context (one per OpenMP thread of a rank)\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\nstruct GpuContext {\n    int device = -1;\n    int max_blocks = 0;\n    double* d_px = nullptr;\n    double* d_py = nullptr;\n    int* d_unclustered = nullptr;\n    int* d_seeds = nullptr;\n    int* d_card = nullptr;\n    int* d_counter = nullptr;\n    int* d_scratch_idx = nullptr;\n    double* d_scratch_d = nullptr;\n    int* d_members = nullptr;\n    cudaStream_t stream = nullptr;\n};\n\nstatic void initGpuContext(GpuContext& ctx, const int device, const std::vector<Point>& points) {\n    const int N = static_cast<int>(points.size());\n    ctx.device = device;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(device));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamCreateWithFlags(&ctx.stream, cudaStreamNonBlocking));\n\n    cudaDeviceProp prop;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDeviceProperties(&prop, device));\n    int blocks_per_sm = 0;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaOccupancyMaxActiveBlocksPerMultiprocessor(&blocks_per_sm, qt_candidate_kernel,\n                                                             QT_BLOCK, 0));\n    if (blocks_per_sm < 1) blocks_per_sm = 1;\n    int max_blocks = prop.multiProcessorCount * blocks_per_sm;\n\n    // Bound the scratch memory (U <= N entries of int + double per block).\n    size_t free_mem = 0, total_mem = 0;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemGetInfo(&free_mem, &total_mem));\n    const size_t budget = free_mem / 2;\n    const size_t per_block = static_cast<size_t>(N) * (sizeof(int) + sizeof(double));\n    const size_t by_mem = std::max<size_t>(1, budget / std::max<size_t>(per_block, 1));\n    if (static_cast<size_t>(max_blocks) > by_mem) max_blocks = static_cast<int>(by_mem);\n    ctx.max_blocks = std::max(1, max_blocks);\n\n    std::vector<double> hx(N), hy(N);\n    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n        hx[i] = points[i].x;\n        hy[i] = points[i].y;\n    }\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&ctx.d_px, N * sizeof(double)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&ctx.d_py, N * sizeof(double)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&ctx.d_unclustered, N * sizeof(int)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&ctx.d_seeds, N * sizeof(int)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&ctx.d_card, N * sizeof(int)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&ctx.d_counter, sizeof(int)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&ctx.d_scratch_idx, static_cast<size_t>(ctx.max_blocks) * N * sizeof(int)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&ctx.d_scratch_d, static_cast<size_t>(ctx.max_blocks) * N * sizeof(double)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&ctx.d_members, N * sizeof(int)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(ctx.d_px, hx.data(), N * sizeof(double), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(ctx.d_py, hy.data(), N * sizeof(double), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n}\n\nstatic void destroyGpuContext(GpuContext& ctx) {\n    if (ctx.device < 0) return;\n    cudaSetDevice(ctx.device);\n    cudaFree(ctx.d_px);\n    cudaFree(ctx.d_py);\n    cudaFree(ctx.d_unclustered);\n    cudaFree(ctx.d_seeds);\n    cudaFree(ctx.d_card);\n    cudaFree(ctx.d_counter);\n    cudaFree(ctx.d_scratch_idx);\n    cudaFree(ctx.d_scratch_d);\n    cudaFree(ctx.d_members);\n    cudaStreamDestroy(ctx.stream);\n    ctx.device = -1;\n}\n\n// Evaluate the cardinality of the candidate cluster for every seed in `seeds`\n// (candidate set = `unclustered`) on one GPU.  If `members` is non-null,\n// `seeds` must hold exactly one seed and the members of its cluster are\n// returned as well.\nstatic void evaluateSeedsOnGpu(GpuContext& ctx,\n                               const std::vector<int>& unclustered,\n                               const int* seeds, const int nseeds,\n                               const double threshold,\n                               int* cardinality,\n                               std::vector<int>* members) {\n    if (nseeds <= 0) return;\n    const int U = static_cast<int>(unclustered.size());\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(ctx.device));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(ctx.d_unclustered, unclustered.data(), U * sizeof(int),\n                               cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, ctx.stream));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(ctx.d_seeds, seeds, nseeds * sizeof(int),\n                               cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, ctx.stream));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemsetAsync(ctx.d_counter, 0, sizeof(int), ctx.stream));\n\n    const int blocks = std::min(ctx.max_blocks, nseeds);\n    qt_candidate_kernel<<<blocks, QT_BLOCK, 0, ctx.stream>>>(\n        ctx.d_px, ctx.d_py, ctx.d_unclustered, U, ctx.d_seeds, nseeds, threshold,\n        ctx.d_counter, ctx.d_card, ctx.d_scratch_idx, ctx.d_scratch_d,\n        members ? ctx.d_members : nullptr);\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(cardinality, ctx.d_card, nseeds * sizeof(int),\n                               cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, ctx.stream));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(ctx.stream));\n    if (members) {\n        members->resize(cardinality[0]);\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(members->data(), ctx.d_members, cardinality[0] * sizeof(int),\n                              cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n    }\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Main QT clustering algorithm (MPI + OpenMP + CUDA)\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\nstd::vector<Cluster> qtClustering(const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                                  const double threshold,\n                                  std::vector<GpuContext>& gpus,\n                                  const int mpi_rank, const int mpi_size) {\n    const int N = static_cast<int>(points.size());\n    const int ngpu = static_cast<int>(gpus.size());\n    std::vector<bool> clustered(N, false);\n    std::vector<int> unclustered_indices;\n    std::vector<Cluster> clusters;\n\n    // Initialize unclustered indices\n    unclustered_indices.reserve(N);\n    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n        unclustered_indices.push_back(i);\n    }\n\n    // Seeds handled by this rank (cyclic distribution for load balance),\n    // split again cyclically over the GPUs of this rank.\n    std::vector<std::vector<int>> gpu_seeds(ngpu);\n    std::vector<std::vector<int>> gpu_card(ngpu);\n    for (int g = 0; g < ngpu; ++g) {\n        gpu_seeds[g].reserve(N / (mpi_size * ngpu) + 1);\n        gpu_card[g].resize(N / (mpi_size * ngpu) + 1);\n    }\n    std::vector<int> best_members;\n\n    // Main clustering loop\n    while (!unclustered_indices.empty()) {\n        const int U = static_cast<int>(unclustered_indices.size());\n\n        // Assign this rank's seeds to its GPUs.\n        for (int g = 0; g < ngpu; ++g) gpu_seeds[g].clear();\n        int local_count = 0;\n        for (int i = mpi_rank; i < U; i += mpi_size, ++local_count) {\n            gpu_seeds[local_count % ngpu].push_back(unclustered_indices[i]);\n        }\n\n        // Try each seed of this rank: one OpenMP thread per GPU.\n#pragma omp parallel for num_threads(ngpu) schedule(static, 1)\n        for (int g = 0; g < ngpu; ++g) {\n            evaluateSeedsOnGpu(gpus[g], unclustered_indices, gpu_seeds[g].data(),\n                               static_cast<int>(gpu_seeds[g].size()), threshold,\n                               gpu_card[g].data(), nullptr);\n        }\n\n        // Local best: maximal cardinality, smallest seed index on ties.\n        int local_best[2] = {-1, INT_MAX};   // {cardinality, seed}\n        for (int g = 0; g < ngpu; ++g) {\n            for (size_t i = 0; i < gpu_seeds[g].size(); ++i) {\n                const int card = gpu_card[g][i];\n                const int seed = gpu_seeds[g][i];\n                if (card > local_best[0] || (card == local_best[0] && seed < local_best[1])) {\n                    local_best[0] = card;\n                    local_best[1] = seed;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Global best via MAXLOC (max value, smallest location on ties).\n        int global_best[2];\n        MPI_CHECK(MPI_Allreduce(local_best, global_best, 1, MPI_2INT, MPI_MAXLOC,\n                                MPI_COMM_WORLD));\n        const int max_cardinality = global_best[0];\n        const int best_seed = global_best[1];\n\n        // If we found a cluster, add it\n        if (best_seed >= 0 && max_cardinality > 0) {\n            // Regenerate the winning cluster's members (deterministic, cheap).\n            int card = 0;\n            evaluateSeedsOnGpu(gpus[0], unclustered_indices, &best_seed, 1, threshold,\n                               &card, &best_members);\n\n            if (mpi_rank == 0) {\n                Cluster cluster;\n                cluster.seed_point = best_seed;\n                cluster.members = best_members;\n                clusters.push_back(cluster);\n            }\n\n            // Mark all members as clustered\n            for (size_t i = 0; i < best_members.size(); ++i) {\n                clustered[best_members[i]] = true;\n            }\n\n            // Remove clustered points from unclustered list\n            unclustered_indices.erase(\n                std::remove_if(unclustered_indices.begin(), unclustered_indices.end(),\n                              [&clustered](int idx) { return clustered[idx]; }),\n                unclustered_indices.end()\n            );\n        } else {\n            // No more clusters can be formed\n            break;\n        }\n    }\n\n    return clusters;\n}\n\n// Validation: check that clusters satisfy the QT clustering properties\nbool validateClusters(const std::vector<Cluster>& clusters,\n                     const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                     const double threshold) {\n    bool valid = true;\n\n    printf(\"Validating clusters:\\n\");\n\n    // Compute the diameter of every cluster (max distance between any two\n    // points) in parallel; the pair loops are flattened over all clusters.\n    std::vector<double> diameters(clusters.size(), 0.0);\n#pragma omp parallel for schedule(dynamic, 1)\n    for (size_t c = 0; c < clusters.size(); ++c) {\n        const auto& cluster = clusters[c];\n        double max_diameter = 0.0;\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < cluster.members.size(); ++i) {\n            for (size_t j = i + 1; j < cluster.members.size(); ++j) {\n                const double dist = distance(points[cluster.members[i]],\n                                           points[cluster.members[j]]);\n                max_diameter = std::max(max_diameter, dist);\n            }\n        }\n        diameters[c] = max_diameter;\n    }\n\n    // Check each cluster\n    for (size_t c = 0; c < clusters.size(); ++c) {\n        const auto& cluster = clusters[c];\n        const double max_diameter = diameters[c];\n\n        if (c < 10) { // Print first 10 clusters\n            printf(\"  Cluster %zu: size=%zu, seed=%d, diameter=%.4f\\n\",\n                   c, cluster.members.size(), cluster.seed_point, max_diameter);\n        }\n\n        // Validate diameter is within threshold\n        if (max_diameter > threshold * 1.001) { // Allow small numerical error\n            printf(\"ERROR: Cluster %zu has diameter %.4f > threshold %.4f\\n\",\n                   c, max_diameter, threshold);\n            valid = false;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Check for duplicate memberships\n    std::vector<int> membership(points.size(), -1);\n    for (size_t c = 0; c < clusters.size(); ++c) {\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < clusters[c].members.size(); ++i) {\n            const int member = clusters[c].members[i];\n            if (membership[member] >= 0) {\n                printf(\"ERROR: Point %d appears in multiple clusters (%d and %zu)\\n\",\n                       member, membership[member], c);\n                valid = false;\n            }\n            membership[member] = static_cast<int>(c);\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Count clustered points\n    int clustered_count = 0;\n#pragma omp parallel for reduction(+ : clustered_count)\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < membership.size(); ++i) {\n        if (membership[i] >= 0) clustered_count++;\n    }\n\n    printf(\"Total points: %zu, Clustered: %d, Unclustered: %zu\\n\",\n           points.size(), clustered_count, points.size() - clustered_count);\n\n    return valid;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Number of points (default: 1000)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -t <float>   Distance threshold for clustering (default: 2.0)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    int provided = 0;\n    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Init_thread(&argc, &argv, MPI_THREAD_FUNNELED, &provided));\n    int mpi_rank = 0, mpi_size = 1;\n    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &mpi_rank));\n    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &mpi_size));\n\n    int num_points = 1000;\n    double threshold = 2.0;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n    int exit_code = 0;\n    bool early_exit = false;\n\n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc && !early_exit; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            num_points = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-t\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            threshold = atof(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            if (mpi_rank == 0) printUsage(argv[0]);\n            early_exit = true;\n            exit_code = 0;\n        } else {\n            if (mpi_rank == 0) {\n                printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n                printUsage(argv[0]);\n            }\n            early_exit = true;\n            exit_code = 1;\n        }\n    }\n    if (early_exit) {\n        MPI_Finalize();\n        return exit_code;\n    }\n\n    if (num_points <= 0 || threshold <= 0.0) {\n        if (mpi_rank == 0) {\n            printf(\"Error: Invalid parameters (num_points=%d, threshold=%.2f)\\n\",\n                   num_points, threshold);\n        }\n        MPI_Finalize();\n        return 1;\n    }\n\n    if (mpi_rank == 0) {\n        printf(\"QT Clustering Benchmark\\n\");\n        printf(\"Number of points: %d\\n\", num_points);\n        printf(\"Distance threshold: %.2f\\n\", threshold);\n        printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n    }\n\n    // Generate synthetic data (deterministic, identical on every rank)\n    std::vector<Point> points(num_points);\n    generateSyntheticData(points, num_points);\n\n    // ---- GPU assignment: ranks sharing a node share its GPUs -------------\n    MPI_Comm node_comm;\n    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Comm_split_type(MPI_COMM_WORLD, MPI_COMM_TYPE_SHARED, mpi_rank,\n                                  MPI_INFO_NULL, &node_comm));\n    int node_rank = 0, node_size = 1;\n    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Comm_rank(node_comm, &node_rank));\n    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Comm_size(node_comm, &node_size));\n    MPI_Comm_free(&node_comm);\n\n    int device_count = 0;\n    if (cudaGetDeviceCount(&device_count) != cudaSuccess || device_count < 1) {\n        fprintf(stderr, \"Rank %d: no CUDA device available\\n\", mpi_rank);\n        MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);\n    }\n    std::vector<int> my_devices;\n    if (node_size >= device_count) {\n        my_devices.push_back(node_rank % device_count);\n    } else {\n        // Fewer ranks than GPUs on this node: spread the GPUs over the ranks.\n        for (int d = node_rank; d < device_count; d += node_size) my_devices.push_back(d);\n    }\n\n    std::vector<GpuContext> gpus(my_devices.size());\n#pragma omp parallel for num_threads(static_cast<int>(my_devices.size())) schedule(static, 1)\n    for (int g = 0; g < static_cast<int>(my_devices.size()); ++g) {\n        initGpuContext(gpus[g], my_devices[g], points);\n    }\n    if (mpi_rank == 0) {\n        printf(\"MPI ranks: %d, GPUs on rank 0: %d, OpenMP threads: %d\\n\",\n               mpi_size, static_cast<int>(my_devices.size()), omp_get_max_threads());\n    }\n\n    // Perform QT clustering\n    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD));\n    auto cluster_start = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n\n    const std::vector<Cluster> clusters = qtClustering(points, threshold, gpus, mpi_rank, mpi_size);\n\n    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD));\n    auto cluster_end = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    auto cluster_time = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(\n        cluster_end - cluster_start);\n\n    for (auto& g : gpus) destroyGpuContext(g);\n\n    if (mpi_rank == 0) {\n        printf(\"Clustering time: %ld ms\\n\", static_cast<long>(cluster_time.count()));\n        printf(\"Clusters found: %zu\\n\", clusters.size());\n\n        // Calculate statistics and performance metrics\n        int One\n//               thread block grows one candidate cluster at a time (dynamic\n//               work distribution with an atomic counter). ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\nstd::vector<Cluster> qtClustering(const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                                  const double threshold,\n                                  std::vector<GpuContext>& gpus,\n                                  const int mpi_rank, const int mpi_size) {\n    const int N = schedule(static, 1)\n        for (int g = 0; g < ngpu; ++g) {\n            evaluateSeedsOnGpu(gpus[g], unclustered_indices, gpu_seeds[g].data(),\n                               static_cast<int>(gpu_seeds[g].size()), threshold,\n                               gpu_card[g].data(), nullptr);\n        }\n\n        // Local best: maximal cardinality, smallest seed index on ties.\n        int local_best[2] = {-1, INT_MAX};   // {cardinality, seed}\n        for (int g = 0; g < ngpu; ++g) {\n            for (size_t i = 0; i < gpu_seeds[g].size(); ++i) {\n                const int std::vector<double> diameters(clusters.size(), 0.0);\n#pragma omp parallel for schedule(dynamic, 1)\n    for (size_t c = 0; c < clusters.size(); ++c) {\n        const auto& cluster = clusters[c];\n They are the dominant cost.\n//\n//   * MPI     : the set of seeds is distributed cyclically over the ranks.\n//               Each rank evaluates its seeds and the globally best seed is\n//               found with a single MPI_MAXLOC all-reduce.  The winning\n//               cluster is then regenerated deterministically on every rank,\n//               so no further communication is required.\n//   * CUDA    : on each rank, candidate clusters are grown on the GPU, one\n//               warp per candidate cluster (dynamic work distribution with an\n//               atomic counter).  See the kernel comments for the exact lazy\n//               evaluation scheme used to grow a cluster.\n//   * OpenMP  : every rank drives all GPUs assigned to it with one OpenMP\n//               thread per GPU (so a single rank per node can still use all\n//               accelerators), and host-side work (candidate list\n//               construction, statistics, validation) is parallelized with\n//               OpenMP as well.\n//\n// The semantics are identical to the sequential version: among the seeds the\n// one with the largest cardinality and, on ties, the smallest index wins; the\n// greedy growth adds the candidate with the smallest resulting diameter and,\n// on ties, the smallest index.\n\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <climits>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <limits>\n#include <numeric>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include <cuda_runtime.h>\n#define OMPI_SKIP_MPICXX 1\n#include <mpi.h>\n#include <omp.h>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\nstatic const double MAX_WIDTH = 20.0;\nstatic const double MAX_HEIGHT = 20.0;\n\n// Structure to represent a point in 2D space\nstruct Point {\n    double x, y;\n};\n\n// Structure to represent a cluster\nstruct Cluster {\n    std::vector<int> members;\n    int seed_point;\n};\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Error handling helpers\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n#define CUDA_CHECK(call)                                                        \\\n    do {                                                                        \\\n        cudaError_t err__ = (call);                                                  \\\n            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);                                       \\\n        }                                                                       \\\n    } while (0)\n\n// Generate synthetic 2D point data in clusters\nvoid generateSyntheticData(std::vector<Point>& points, const int N, unsigned int seed = 42) {\n    auto frand = [&seed]() mutable { return rand_r(&seed) / static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX); };\n\n    const double min_dim = std::min(MAX_WIDTH, MAX_HEIGHT);\n    int count = 0;\n\n    while (count < N) {\n        // Create group_cnt points within a circle of radius R\n        // around center point (cntr_x, cntr_y)\n        const double cntr_x = frand() * MAX_WIDTH;\n        const double cntr_y = frand() * MAX_HEIGHT;\n        const double R = frand() * min_dim / 2.0;\n        int group_cnt = static_cast<int>(frand() * (N / 30.0));\n\n        // Make sure we don't make more points than we need\n        if (group_cnt > (N - count)) {\n            group_cnt = N - count;\n        }\n\n        while (group_cnt > 0) {\n            const double sign = (frand() < 0.5) ? -1.0 : 1.0;\n            const double r = frand() * R;\n            const double dx = (2.0 * frand() - 1.0) * r;\n            const double dy = std::sqrt(r * r - dx * dx) * sign;\n            const double x = cntr_x + dx;\n            const double y = cntr_y + dy;\n\n            if (x < 0 || x > MAX_WIDTH || y < 0 || y > MAX_HEIGHT) {\n                continue;\n            }\n\n            points[count] = {x, y};\n            count++;\n            group_cnt--;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Calculate Euclidean distance between two points\ninline double distance(const Point& p1, const Point& p2) {\n    double dx = p1.x - p2.x;\n    double dy = p1.y - p2.y;\n    return std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Exactness notes for the GPU implementation\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// The sequential code compares distances d = sqrt(dx*dx + dy*dy).  The GPU\n// works with the squared distance s = dx*dx + dy*dy (correctly rounded, no\n// FMA contraction) instead and reconstructs the exact sequential semantics:\n//   * max over members:  sqrt(max s) == max sqrt(s)   (sqrt is monotonic)\n//   * d < threshold  <=>  s < S_crit, where S_crit is the smallest double\n//     with sqrt(S_crit) >= threshold (computed once on the host).\n//   * arg-min:  the sequential code picks the candidate with the smallest d\n//     and, on ties, the smallest index.  Two *different* s values can round\n//     to the same sqrt only if they are within a few ulps of each other.  The\n//     fast path therefore does the arg-min on (s, index) and raises a flag if\n//     any comparison involved two distinct values within NEAR_ULPS ulps; the\n//     (practically never taken) slow path then redoes the arg-min on\n//     (sqrt(s), index) exactly like the sequential code.\n// All ordering comparisons of squared distances are done on the IEEE-754 bit\n// patterns reinterpreted as signed 64-bit integers.  For non-negative doubles\n// (including +inf, used as the \"empty\" sentinel) this order is identical to\n// the floating-point order, and integer compares run at full rate while FP64\n// compares run at 1/64 rate on consumer GPUs.\n// Additionally an FP32 pre-filter (with a generous error margin) skips the\n// expensive FP64 evaluation whenever the result provably cannot change a\n// candidate's current maximum, or provably exceeds the threshold.\n//\n// Lazy evaluation (exact)\n// -----------------------\n// The diameter d_k of the greedy cluster after k additions is non-decreasing\n// in k.  A candidate c whose current max squared distance s_c (to the members\n// known so far) exceeds a bound D can therefore not be chosen before the\n// diameter reaches D.  Each warp keeps\n//   * an ACTIVE set:  candidates with up-to-date s_c <= D, scanned at every\n//     growth step (arg-min + update with the new member), and\n//   * a DORMANT set:  candidates with a lower bound L_c > D on s_c and the\n//     number of members already accounted for.  They are only touched when\n//     the arg-min over the active set gets within NEAR_ULPS of D; then D is\n//     raised, dormant candidates with L_c <= D are \"caught up\" (distances to\n//     the members they missed; stops early as soon as the bound exceeds D)\n//     and moved to the active set if s_c <= D.\n// Since all dormant candidates satisfy L_c > D >= a + NEAR_ULPS ulps (a being\n// the active arg-min), neither exact ties nor sqrt-rounding ties with\n// dormant candidates are possible, so this is exact.\n\nstatic const int QT_BLOCK = 256;               // 8 warps per block\nstatic const int QT_WARPS = QT_BLOCK / 32;\nstatic const long long NEAR_ULPS = 8;\nstatic const int ACTIVE_TARGET = 96;           // desired active candidates per warp\n// FP32 pre-filter safety margins (relative and absolute, in squared units).\n// The FP32 squared distance error for coordinates in [0, 20] is < 1e-3\n// and well below (1 - F32_REL) * s + F32_ABS for every relevant s.\nstatic const float F32_REL = 0.999f;\nstatic const float F32_ABS = 2e-3f;\n\ntypedef long long sbits_t;\n#define SBITS_INF 0x7FF0000000000000LL\n#define DELTA_MIN (1LL << 40)\n#define DELTA_INIT (1LL << 49)\n#define DELTA_MAX (1LL << 54)\n\n// Smallest double s such that sqrt(s) >= threshold (sqrt monotonic + correctly rounded).\nstatic double computeSquaredCritical(const double threshold) {\n    double s = threshold * threshold;\n    while (std::sqrt(s) >= threshold) s = std::nextafter(s, -std::numeric_limits<double>::infinity());\n    while (std::sqrt(s) < threshold) s = std::nextafter(s, std::numeric_limits<double>::infinity());\n    return s;\n}\n\nstatic sbits_t hostDoubleBits(double d) {\n    sbits_t b;\n    memcpy(&b, &d, sizeof(b));\n    return b;\n}\n\n__device__ __forceinline__ double dev_sqdist(double x1, double y1, double x2, double y2) {\n    const double dx = x1 - x2;\n    const double dy = y1 - y2;\n    return __dadd_rn(__dmul_rn(dx, dx), __dmul_rn(dy, dy));\n}\n\n__device__ __forceinline__ float dev_sqdist_f(float x1, float y1, float x2, float y2) {\n    const float dx = x1 - x2;\n    const float dy = y1 - y2;\n    return fmaf(dx, dx, dy * dy);\n}\n\n// Float value <= the double with bit pattern sb (truncation, integer ops only).\n__device__ __forceinline__ float bits_to_float_trunc(sbits_t sb) {\n    const int e = static_cast<int>(sb >> 32) - 0x38000000;   // rebias exponent 1023 -> 127\n    return (e <= 0) ? 0.0f : __int_as_float(e << 3);\n}\n\n// True if a != b and the two (non-negative) doubles are within NEAR_ULPS ulps.\n__device__ __forceinline__ bool dev_near(sbits_t a, sbits_t b) {\n    const sbits_t d = a - b;\n    return (d != 0) && (d <= NEAR_ULPS) && (d >= -NEAR_ULPS);\n}\n\n// Warp-wide arg-min over (value, index) pairs; ties resolved by smaller index.\n// Butterfly pattern: every lane ends up with the result.  `flag` collects\n// whether any pair of distinct near-equal values was compared.\n__device__ __forceinline__ void warp_argmin(sbits_t& d, int& i, bool& flag) {\n#pragma unroll\n    for (int off = 16; off > 0; off >>= 1) {\n        const sbits_t od = __shfl_xor_sync(0xffffffffu, d, off);\n        const int oi = __shfl_xor_sync(0xffffffffu, i, off);\n        const int of = __shfl_xor_sync(0xffffffffu, static_cast<int>(flag), off);\n        flag = flag || (of != 0) || dev_near(od, d);\n        if (od < d || (od == d && oi < i)) {\n            d = od;\n            i = oi;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n__device__ __forceinline__ sbits_t warp_min_ll(sbits_t v) {\n#pragma unroll\n    for (int off = 16; off > 0; off >>= 1) {\n        const sbits_t o = __shfl_xor_sync(0xffffffffu, v, off);\n        v = (o < v) ? o : v;\n    }\n    return v;\n}\n\n__device__ __forceinline__ int warp_sum_int(int v) {\n#pragma unroll\n    for (int off = 16; off > 0; off >>= 1) v += __shfl_xor_sync(0xffffffffu, v, off);\n    return v;\n}\n\n// Track the running local (s, index) minimum plus the near-tie flag.\n__device__ __forceinline__ void track_min(sbits_t s, int i, sbits_t& ls, int& li, bool& flag) {\n    if (s < ls) {\n        flag = flag || dev_near(s, ls);\n        ls = s;\n        li = i;\n    } else if (s == ls) {\n        li = (i < li) ? i : li;\n    } else {\n        flag = flag || dev_near(s, ls);\n    }\n}\n\n// First index in [0, n) with a[i] >= v (a sorted ascending).\n__device__ __forceinline__ int dev_lower_bound(const float* __restrict__ a, int n, float v) {\n    int lo = 0, hi = n;\n    while (lo < hi) {\n        const int mid = (lo + hi) >> 1;\n        if (a[mid] < v) lo = mid + 1; else hi = mid;\n    }\n    return lo;\n}\n\n// Per-warp scratch (lane-strided layout: lane l owns slots l + j*32).\nstruct WarpScratch {\n    int* a_idx;      // active candidates\n    sbits_t* a_s;\n    int* d_idx;      // dormant candidates\n    sbits_t* d_s;    // lower bound on s (exact for the members accounted for)\n    int* d_k0;       // number of members accounted for\n    int* m_idx;      // members (point indices) of the cluster being grown\n    float2* m_xy;    // members (float coordinates)\n};\n\nenum { CU_ACTIVE = 0, CU_DORMANT = 1, CU_DROP = 2 };\n\n// Bring candidate c (bound sb covering members [0, k0)) up to date with the\n// members [k0, k), stopping as soon as the bound exceeds `limit`.\n__device__ __forceinline__ int catch_up(const double* __restrict__ px, const double* __restrict__ py,\n                                        const int* __restrict__ m_idx, const float2* __restrict__ m_xy,\n                                        const double cx, const double cy, const float fx, const float fy,\n                                        sbits_t& sb, int& k0, const int k,\n                                        const sbits_t limit, const sbits_t s_crit_bits) {\n    float sf = bits_to_float_trunc(sb);\n    for (int m = k0; m < k; ++m) {\n        const float2 mc = m_xy[m];\n        if (dev_sqdist_f(mc.x, mc.y, fx, fy) >= fmaf(sf, F32_REL, -F32_ABS)) {\n            const int mi = m_idx[m];\n            const sbits_t sm = __double_as_longlong(dev_sqdist(px[mi], py[mi], cx, cy));\n            if (sm > sb) {\n                sb = sm;\n                if (!(sb < s_crit_bits)) return CU_DROP;\n                if (sb > limit) {\n                    k0 = m + 1;\n                    return CU_DORMANT;\n                }\n                sf = bits_to_float_trunc(sb);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    k0 = k;\n    return CU_ACTIVE;\n}\n\n__global__ void __launch_bounds__(QT_BLOCK)\nqt_candidate_kernel(const double* __restrict__ px,\n                    const double* __restrict__ py,\n                    const float* __restrict__ pxf,\n                    const float* __restrict__ pyf,\n                    const int* __restrict__ ux_idx,        // unclustered indices sorted by x\n                    const float* __restrict__ ux_f,        // their float x coordinates (ascending)\n                    const int U,\n                    const int* __restrict__ seeds,         // seeds to evaluate\n                    const int nseeds,\n                    const double s_crit,                   // keep iff s < s_crit\n                    const float thr_slab,                  // threshold + float margin\n                    int* __restrict__ work_counter,        // dynamic seed scheduling\n                    int* __restrict__ cardinality_out,     // per seed\n                    WarpScratch ws,\n                    const int cap_warp,                    // scratch entries per warp (multiple of 32)\n                    const int cap_members,                 // member slots per warp\n                    int* __restrict__ members_out)         // optional (nseeds == 1)\n{\n    const int lane = threadIdx.x & 31;\n    const int gw = blockIdx.x * QT_WARPS + (threadIdx.x >> 5);\n    const size_t base = static_cast<size_t>(gw) * cap_warp;\n    int* a_idx = ws.a_idx + base;\n    sbits_t* a_s = ws.a_s + base;\n    int* d_idx = ws.d_idx + base;\n    sbits_t* d_s = ws.d_s + base;\n    int* d_k0 = ws.d_k0 + base;\n    int* m_idx = ws.m_idx + static_cast<size_t>(gw) * cap_members;\n    float2* m_xy = ws.m_xy + static_cast<size_t>(gw) * cap_members;\n#define SLOT(j) (lane + ((j) << 5))\n\n    const sbits_t s_crit_bits = __double_as_longlong(s_crit);\n    // FP32 bound above which a squared distance certainly exceeds s_crit.\n    const float s_crit_hi_f = fmaf(static_cast<float>(s_crit), 1.0f + (1.0f - F32_REL), F32_ABS);\n\n    for (;;) {\n        int task = 0;\n        if (lane == 0) task = atomicAdd(work_counter, 1);\n        task = __shfl_sync(0xffffffffu, task, 0);\n        if (task >= nseeds) break;\n\n        const int seed = seeds[task];\n        const double sx = px[seed];\n        const double sy = py[seed];\n        const float sxf = pxf[seed];\n        const float syf = pyf[seed];\n\n        // Candidates: unclustered points in the x-slab around the seed with\n        // dist(seed, c) < threshold (points farther away can never be added\n        // since the diameter only grows).  All start dormant with the exact\n        // distance to the seed as bound (members [0, 1) accounted).\n        const int lo = dev_lower_bound(ux_f, U, sxf - thr_slab);\n        const int hi = dev_lower_bound(ux_f, U, sxf + thr_slab);\n        int cnt_a = 0, cnt_d = 0;\n        sbits_t lmin = SBITS_INF;      // min bound over this lane's dormant candidates\n        for (int j = lo + lane; j < hi; j += 32) {\n            const int c = ux_idx[j];\n            if (c == seed) continue;\n            const float fx = pxf[c];\n            const float fy = pyf[c];\n            if (dev_sqdist_f(sxf, syf, fx, fy) > s_crit_hi_f) continue;   // certainly too far\n            const sbits_t sb = __double_as_longlong(dev_sqdist(sx, sy, px[c], py[c]));\n            if (!(sb < s_crit_bits)) continue;\n            d_idx[SLOT(cnt_d)] = c;\n            d_s[SLOT(cnt_d)] = sb;\n            d_k0[SLOT(cnt_d)] = 1;\n            ++cnt_d;\n            lmin = (sb < lmin) ? sb : lmin;\n        }\n\n        int k = 1;   // number of members\n        if (lane == 0) {\n            m_idx[0] = seed;\n            m_xy[0] = make_float2(sxf, syf);\n            if (members_out != nullptr) members_out[0] = seed;\n        }\n        sbits_t D = -1;                // active set == candidates with s <= D\n        sbits_t delta = DELTA_INIT;\n        sbits_t ls = SBITS_INF;        // running local arg-min over active candidates\n        int li = INT_MAX;\n        bool flag = false;\n        __syncwarp();\n\n        for (;;) {\n            sbits_t a = ls;\n            int best = li;\n            bool near = flag;\n            warp_argmin(a, best, near);\n\n            const bool need = (a == SBITS_INF) ? __any_sync(0xffffffffu, cnt_d > 0)\n                                               : (a + NEAR_ULPS > D);\n            if (need) {\n                for (;;) {\n                    if (!__any_sync(0xffffffffu, cnt_d > 0)) break;\n                    sbits_t Dn = D + delta;\n                    const sbits_t lmin_w = warp_min_ll(lmin);\n                    Dn = (lmin_w > Dn) ? lmin_w : Dn;\n                    if (a != SBITS_INF && a + NEAR_ULPS > Dn) Dn = a + NEAR_ULPS;\n\n                    // Scan this lane's dormant candidates.\n                    sbits_t new_lmin = SBITS_INF;\n                    int wd = 0;\n                    for (int j = 0; j < cnt_d; ++j) {\n                        const int c = d_idx[SLOT(j)];\n                        sbits_t sb = d_s[SLOT(j)];\n                        int k0 = d_k0[SLOT(j)];\n                        if (sb <= Dn) {\n                            const int st = catch_up(px, py, m_idx, m_xy, px[c], py[c], pxf[c], pyf[c],\n                                                    sb, k0, k, Dn, s_crit_bits);\n                            if (st == CU_DROP) continue;\n                            if (st == CU_ACTIVE) {\n                                a_idx[SLOT(cnt_a)] = c;\n                                a_s[SLOT(cnt_a)] = sb;\n                                ++cnt_a;\n                                track_min(sb, c, ls, li, flag);\n                                continue;\n                            }\n                        }\n                        d_idx[SLOT(wd)] = c;\n                        d_s[SLOT(wd)] = sb;\n                        d_k0[SLOT(wd)] = k0;\n                        ++wd;\n                        new_lmin = (sb < new_lmin) ? sb : new_lmin;\n                    }\n                    cnt_d = wd;\n                    lmin = new_lmin;\n                    D = Dn;\n\n                    a = ls;\n                    best = li;\n                    near = flag;\n                    warp_argmin(a, best, near);\n                    if (a != SBITS_INF && a + NEAR_ULPS <= D) break;\n                    delta = (delta < DELTA_MAX) ? (delta << 1) : DELTA_MAX;\n                }\n                // Keep the active set around the target size.\n                const int tot = warp_sum_int(cnt_a);\n                if (tot > 2 * ACTIVE_TARGET) {\n                    delta = (delta > DELTA_MIN) ? (delta >> 1) : DELTA_MIN;\n                } else if (tot < ACTIVE_TARGET / 2) {\n                    delta = (delta < DELTA_MAX) ? (delta << 1) : DELTA_MAX;\n                }\n            }\n            if (best == INT_MAX) break;   // no candidate keeps diameter < threshold\n\n            if (near) {\n                // Slow exact path: arg-min on (sqrt(s), index) as in the\n                // sequential code (only the active set can be involved).\n                sbits_t es = SBITS_INF;\n                int ei = INT_MAX;\n                bool dummy = false;\n                for (int j = 0; j < cnt_a; ++j) {\n                    const sbits_t v = __double_as_longlong(sqrt(__longlong_as_double(a_s[SLOT(j)])));\n                    const int i = a_idx[SLOT(j)];\n                    if (v < es || (v == es && i < ei)) {\n                        es = v;\n                        ei = i;\n                    }\n                }\n                warp_argmin(es, ei, dummy);\n                best = ei;\n            }\n\n            // Add the new member.\n            const double mx = px[best];\n            const double my = py[best];\n            const float mxf = pxf[best];\n            const float myf = pyf[best];\n            if (lane == 0) {\n                m_idx[k] = best;\n                m_xy[k] = make_float2(mxf, myf);\n                if (members_out != nullptr) members_out[k] = best;\n            }\n            ++k;\n\n            // Update the active candidates with the new member: drop those\n            // out of range, demote those above D, compact the rest and track\n            // the next local arg-min on the fly.\n            ls = SBITS_INF;\n            li = INT_MAX;\n            flag = false;\n            int w = 0;\n            for (int j = 0; j < cnt_a; ++j) {\n                const int c = a_idx[SLOT(j)];\n                if (c == best) continue;\n                sbits_t sb = a_s[SLOT(j)];\n                if (dev_sqdist_f(mxf, myf, pxf[c], pyf[c]) >= fmaf(bits_to_float_trunc(sb), F32_REL, -F32_ABS)) {\n                    const sbits_t sm = __double_as_longlong(dev_sqdist(mx, my, px[c], py[c]));\n                    if (sm > sb) {\n                        sb = sm;\n                        if (!(sb < s_crit_bits)) continue;\n                        if (sb > D) {\n                            d_idx[SLOT(cnt_d)] = c;\n                            d_s[SLOT(cnt_d)] = sb;\n                            d_k0[SLOT(cnt_d)] = k;\n                            ++cnt_d;\n                            lmin = (sb < lmin) ? sb : lmin;\n                            continue;\n                        }\n                    }\n                }\n                a_idx[SLOT(w)] = c;\n                a_s[SLOT(w)] = sb;\n                ++w;\n                track_min(sb, c, ls, li, flag);\n            }\n            cnt_a = w;\n            __syncwarp();   // member list visible to all lanes before the next catch-up\n        }\n\n        if (lane == 0) cardinality_out[task] = k;\n    }\n#undef SLOT\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Per-GPU context (one per OpenMP thread of a rank)\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\nstruct GpuContext {\n    int device = -1;\n    int max_blocks = 0;\n    int cap_warp = 0;\n    int cap_members = 0;\n    double* d_px = nullptr;\n    double* d_py = nullptr;\n    float* d_pxf = nullptr;\n    float* d_pyf = nullptr;\n    int* d_ux_idx = nullptr;\n    float* d_ux_f = nullptr;\n    int* d_seeds = nullptr;\n    int* d_card = nullptr;\n    int* d_counter = nullptr;\n    int* d_members = nullptr;\n    WarpScratch ws = {nullptr, nullptr, nullptr, nullptr, nullptr, nullptr, nullptr};\n    cudaStream_t stream = nullptr;\n};\n\nstatic void initGpuContext(GpuContext& ctx, const int device, const std::vector<Point>& points) {\n    const int N = static_cast<int>(points.size());\n    ctx.device = device;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(device));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamCreateWithFlags(&ctx.stream, cudaStreamNonBlocking));\n\n    cudaDeviceProp prop;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDeviceProperties(&prop, device));\n    int blocks_per_sm = 0;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaOccupancyMaxActiveBlocksPerMultiprocessor(&blocks_per_sm, qt_candidate_kernel,\n                                                             QT_BLOCK, 0));\n    if (blocks_per_sm < 1) blocks_per_sm = 1;\n    int max_blocks = prop.multiProcessorCount * blocks_per_sm;\n\n    ctx.cap_warp = ((N + 31) / 32) * 32;\n    ctx.cap_members = N;\n    const size_t per_warp = static_cast<size_t>(ctx.cap_warp) * (2 * sizeof(int) + 2 * sizeof(sbits_t) + sizeof(int))\n                          + static_cast<size_t>(ctx.cap_members) * (sizeof(int) + sizeof(float2));\n    const size_t per_block = per_warp * QT_WARPS;\n\n    // Bound the scratch memory.\n    size_t free_mem = 0, total_mem = 0;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemGetInfo(&free_mem, &total_mem));\n    const size_t budget = free_mem / 2;\n    const size_t by_mem = std::max<size_t>(1, budget / std::max<size_t>(per_block, 1));\n    if (static_cast<size_t>(max_blocks) > by_mem) max_blocks = static_cast<int>(by_mem);\n    ctx.max_blocks = std::max(1, max_blocks);\n\n    std::vector<double> hx(N), hy(N);\n    std::vector<float> hxf(N), hyf(N);\n    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n        hx[i] = points[i].x;\n        hy[i] = points[i].y;\n        hxf[i] = static_cast<float>(points[i].x);\n        hyf[i] = static_cast<float>(points[i].y);\n    }\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&ctx.d_px, N * sizeof(double)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&ctx.d_py, N * sizeof(double)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&ctx.d_pxf, N * sizeof(float)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&ctx.d_pyf, N * sizeof(float)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&ctx.d_ux_idx, N * sizeof(int)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&ctx.d_ux_f, N * sizeof(float)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&ctx.d_seeds, N * sizeof(int)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&ctx.d_card, N * sizeof(int)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&ctx.d_counter, sizeof(int)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&ctx.d_members, N * sizeof(int)));\n    const size_t nwarps = static_cast<size_t>(ctx.max_blocks) * QT_WARPS;\n    const size_t entries = nwarps * ctx.cap_warp;\n    const size_t mentries = nwarps * ctx.cap_members;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&ctx.ws.a_idx, entries * sizeof(int)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&ctx.ws.a_s, entries * sizeof(sbits_t)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&ctx.ws.d_idx, entries * sizeof(int)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&ctx.ws.d_s, entries * sizeof(sbits_t)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&ctx.ws.d_k0, entries * sizeof(int)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&ctx.ws.m_idx, mentries * sizeof(int)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&ctx.ws.m_xy, mentries * sizeof(float2)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(ctx.d_px, hx.data(), N * sizeof(double), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(ctx.d_py, hy.data(), N * sizeof(double), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(ctx.d_pxf, hxf.data(), N * sizeof(float), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(ctx.d_pyf, hyf.data(), N * sizeof(float), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n}\n\nstatic void destroyGpuContext(GpuContext& ctx) {\n    if (ctx.device < 0) return;\n    cudaSetDevice(ctx.device);\n    cudaFree(ctx.d_px);\n    cudaFree(ctx.d_py);\n    cudaFree(ctx.d_pxf);\n    cudaFree(ctx.d_pyf);\n    cudaFree(ctx.d_ux_idx);\n    cudaFree(ctx.d_ux_f);\n    cudaFree(ctx.d_seeds);\n    cudaFree(ctx.d_card);\n    cudaFree(ctx.d_counter);\n    cudaFree(ctx.d_members);\n    cudaFree(ctx.ws.a_idx);\n    cudaFree(ctx.ws.a_s);\n    cudaFree(ctx.ws.d_idx);\n    cudaFree(ctx.ws.d_s);\n    cudaFree(ctx.ws.d_k0);\n    cudaFree(ctx.ws.m_idx);\n    cudaFree(ctx.ws.m_xy);\n    cudaStreamDestroy(ctx.stream);\n    ctx.device = -1;\n}\n\n// Candidate set for one outer iteration: the unclustered points sorted by x.\nstruct CandidateSet {\n    std::vector<int> idx;     // point indices, ascending x\n    std::vector<float> xf;    // float x coordinate of idx[i]\n};\n\n// Evaluate the cardinality of the candidate cluster for every seed in `seeds`\n// on one GPU.  If `members` is non-null, `seeds` must hold exactly one seed\n// and the members of its cluster are returned as well.\nstatic void evaluateSeedsOnGpu(GpuContext& ctx,\n                               const CandidateSet& cand,\n                               const int* seeds, const int nseeds,\n                               const double s_crit, const float thr_slab,\n                               int* cardinality,\n                               std::vector<int>* members) {\n    if (nseeds <= 0) return;\n    const int U = static_cast<int>(cand.idx.size());\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(ctx.device));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(ctx.d_ux_idx, cand.idx.data(), U * sizeof(int),\n                               cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, ctx.stream));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(ctx.d_ux_f, cand.xf.data(), U * sizeof(float),\n                               cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, ctx.stream));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(ctx.d_seeds, seeds, nseeds * sizeof(int),\n                               cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, ctx.stream));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemsetAsync(ctx.d_counter, 0, sizeof(int), ctx.stream));\n\n    const int blocks = std::min(ctx.max_blocks, (nseeds + QT_WARPS - 1) / QT_WARPS);\n    qt_candidate_kernel<<<blocks, QT_BLOCK, 0, ctx.stream>>>(\n        ctx.d_px, ctx.d_py, ctx.d_pxf, ctx.d_pyf, ctx.d_ux_idx, ctx.d_ux_f, U,\n        ctx.d_seeds, nseeds, s_crit, thr_slab, ctx.d_counter, ctx.d_card,\n        ctx.ws, ctx.cap_warp, ctx.cap_members, members ? ctx.d_members : nullptr);\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(cardinality, ctx.d_card, nseeds * sizeof(int),\n                               cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, ctx.stream));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(ctx.stream));\n    if (members) {\n        members->resize(cardinality[0]);\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(members->data(), ctx.d_members, cardinality[0] * sizeof(int),\n                              cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n    }\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Main QT clustering algorithm (MPI + OpenMP + CUDA)\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\nstd::vector<Cluster> qtClustering(const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                                  const double threshold,\n                                  std::vector<GpuContext>& gpus,\n                                  const int mpi_rank, const int mpi_size) {\n    const int N = static_cast<int>(points.size());\n    const int ngpu = static_cast<int>(gpus.size());\n    const double s_crit = computeSquaredCritical(threshold);\n    // x-slab half width in float with margin for the double->float rounding.\n    const float thr_slab = static_cast<float>(threshold) * (1.0f + 1e-5f) + 1e-4f;\n    std::vector<bool> clustered(N, false);\n    std::vector<int> unclustered_indices;\n    std::vector<Cluster> clusters;\n\n    // Initialize unclustered indices\n    unclustered_indices.reserve(N);\n    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n        unclustered_indices.push_back(i);\n    }\n\n x_order.end(),\n                     [&points](int a, int b) { return points[a].x < points[b].x; });\n    CandidateSet cand;\n    cand.idx.reserve(N);\n    cand.xf.reserve(N);\n\n    // Seeds handled points in x order.\n        cand.idx.clear();\n        cand.xf.clear();\n        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n            const int p = x_order[i];\n            if (!clustered[p]) {\n                cand.idx.push_back(p);\n                cand.xf.push_back(static_cast<float>(points[p].x));\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Assign this rank's seeds to its GPUs.\n        for (int g = 0; g < ngpu; ++g) gpu_seeds[g].clear();\n        int local_count = 0;\n        for (int i = mpi_rank; i < U; i += mpi_size, ++local_count) {\n            gpu_seeds[local_count % ngpu].push_back(unclustered_indices[i]);\n        }\n\n        // Try each seed of this rank: one OpenMP thread per GPU.\n#pragma omp parallel for num_threads(ngpu) schedule(static, 1)\n        for (int g = 0; g < ngpu; ++g) {\n            evaluateSeedsOnGpu(gpus[g], cand, gpu_seeds[g].data(),\n                               static_cast<int>(gpu_seeds[g].size()), s_crit, thr_slab,\n                               gpu_card[g].data(), nullptr);\n        }\n\n        // Local best: maximal cardinality, smallest seed index on ties.\n        int local_best[2] = {-1, INT_MAX};   // {cardinality, seed}\n        for (int g = 0; g < ngpu; ++g) {\n            for (size_t i = 0; i < gpu_seeds[g].size(); ++i) {\n                const int card = gpu_card[g][i];\n                const int seed = gpu_seeds[g][i];\n                if (card > local_best[0] || (card == local_best[0] && seed < local_best[1])) {\n                    local_best[0] = card;\n                    local_best[1] = seed;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Global best via MAXLOC (max value, smallest location on ties).\n        int global_best[2];\n        MPI_CHECK(MPI_Allreduce(local_best, global_best, 1, MPI_2INT, MPI_MAXLOC,\n                                MPI_COMM_WORLD));\n        const int max_cardinality = global_best[0];\n        const int best_seed = global_best[1];\n\n        // If we found a cluster, add it\n        if (best_seed >= 0 && max_cardinality > 0) {\n            // Regenerate the winning cluster's members (deterministic, cheap).\n            int card = 0;\n            evaluateSeedsOnGpu(gpus[0], cand, &best_seed, 1, s_crit, thr_slab,\n                               &card, &best_members);\n\n            if (mpi_rank == 0) {\n                Cluster cluster;\n                cluster.seed_point = best_seed;\n                cluster.members = best_members;\n                clusters.push_back(cluster);\n            }\n\n            // Mark all members as clustered\n            for (size_t i = 0; i < best_members.size(); ++i) {\n                clustered[best_members[i]] = true;\n            }\n\n            // Remove clustered points from unclustered list\n            unclustered_indices.erase(\n                std::remove_if(unclustered_indices.begin(), unclustered_indices.end(),\n                              [&clustered](int idx) { return clustered[idx]; }),\n                unclustered_indices.end()\n            );\n        } else {\n            // No more clusters can be formed\n            break;\n        }\n    }\n\n    return off > 0; off >>= 1) {\n        const sbits_t o = __shfl_xor_sync(FULL_MASK, v, off);\n        v = (o < v) ? o : v;\n    }\n    return v;\n}\n\n// Track the running local (s, index) minimum plus the near-tie flag.\n__device__ __forceinline__ void track_min(sbits_t s, int i, sbits_t& ls, int& li, bool& flag,\n                                          sbits_t tiny) {\n    if (s < ls) {\n        flag = flag || dev_near(s, ls, tiny);\n        ls = s;\n        li = i;\n    } else if (s == ls) {\n        li = (i < li) ? i : li;\n    } else {\n        flag = flag || dev_near(s, ls, tiny);\n    }\n}\n\n// First index in [0, n) with a[i] >= v (a sorted ascending).\n__device__ __forceinline__ int dev_lower_bound(const float* __restrict__ a, int n, float v) {\n    int lo = 0, hi = n;\n    while (lo < hi) {\n        const int mid = (lo + hi) >> 1;\n        if (a[mid] < v) lo = mid + 1; else hi = mid;\n    }\n    return lo;\n}\n\n// Exact orientation predicate on fixed-point coordinates (|coord| < 2^62):\n// sign of (b - a) x (c - a), evaluated with 128-bit products.\n__device__ __forceinline__ int orient_exact(long long ax, long long ay, long long bx, long long by,\n                                            long long cx, long long cy) {\n    const long long d1x = bx - ax, d1y = cy - ay, d2x = by - ay, d2y = cx - ax;\n    const long long h1 = __mul64hi(d1x, d1y);\n    const unsigned long long l1 = static_cast<unsigned long long>(d1x) * static_cast<unsigned long long>(d1y);\n    const long long h2 = __mul64hi(d2x, d2y);\n    const unsigned long long l2 = static_cast<unsigned long long>(d2x) * static_cast<unsigned long long>(d2y);\n    if (h1 != h2) return (h1 > h2) ? 1 : -1;\n    return (l1 > l2) ? 1 : ((l1 < l2) ? -1 : 0);\n}\n\n// Per-warp global scratch (warp-level lists, uniform counts).\nstruct WarpScratch {\n    int* a_idx;      // active candidates (overflow beyond A_CAP)\n    sbits_t* a_s;\n    int* n_idx;      // near-dormant candidates (overflow beyond N_CAP)\n    sbits_t* n_s;\n    int* n_k0;\n    int* f_idx;      // far-dormant candidates (bound > D_far)\n    sbits_t* f_s;\n    int* f_k0;\n    int* e_pos;      // evaluation list (positions in the near list)\n    int* m_idx;      // members (point indices) of the cluster being grown\n    float2* m_xy;    // members (float coordinates)\n};\n\n// Per-warp shared memory: convex hull of the members, active set and the\n// near-dormant tier (hot data), histogram for the bound selection.\nstruct WarpShared {\n    double hx[H_MAX], hy[H_MAX];\n    long long hix[H_MAX], hiy[H_MAX];\n    float hfx[H_MAX], hfy[H_MAX];\n    int a_idx[A_CAP];\n    sbits_t a_s[A_CAP];\n    float a_fx[A_CAP], a_fy[A_CAP];\n    int n_idx[N_CAP];\n    sbits_t n_s[N_CAP];\n    int n_k0[N_CAP];\n    int hist[32];\n};\n\n// Insert member point p into the hull (warp-collective).  `valid` becomes\n// false if the hull overflows; then bounds fall back to the full member list.\n__device__ void hull_insert(WarpShared& H, int& h, bool& valid, const int lane,\n                            const double x, const double y, const long long ix, const long long iy,\n                            const float fx, const float fy) {\n    if (!valid) return;\n    if (h <= 2) {\n        if (h == 0) {\n            if (lane == 0) { H.hx[0] = x; H.hy[0] = y; H.hix[0] = ix; H.hiy[0] = iy; H.hfx[0] = fx; H.hfy[0] = fy; }\n            h = 1;\n        } else if (h == 1) {\n            if (ix == H.hix[0] && iy == H.hiy[0]) { __syncwarp(); return; }   // duplicate\n            if (lane == 0) { H.hx[1] = x; H.hy[1] = y; H.hix[1] = ix; H.hiy[1] = iy; H.hfx[1] = fx; H.hfy[1] = fy; }\n            h = 2;\n        } else {\n            const int o = orient_exact(H.hix[0], H.hiy[0], H.hix[1], H.hiy[1], ix, iy);\n            if (o > 0) {\n                if (lane == 0) { H.hx[2] = x; H.hy[2] = y; H.hix[2] = ix; H.hiy[2] = iy; H.hfx[2] = fx; H.hfy[2] = fy; }\n                h = 3;\n            } else if (o < 0) {\n                if (lane == 0) {\n                    H.hx[2] = H.hx[1]; H.hix[0] : H.hiy[0];\n                const long long b = usex ? H.hix[1] : H.hiy[1];\n                const long long p = usex ? ix : iy;\n                int rep = -1;\n                if (a < b) { if (p < a) rep = 0; else if (p > b) rep = 1; }\n                else       { if (p > a) rep = 0; else if (p < b) rep = 1; }\n                if (rep >= 0 && lane == 0) { H.hx[rep] = x; H.hy[rep] = y; H.hix[rep] = ix; H.hiy[rep] = iy; H.hfx[rep] = fx; H.hfy[rep] = fy; }\n            }\n        }\n        __syncwarp();\n        return;\n    }\n\n    // h >= 3: non-degenerate CCW polygon.  Edge i = (K[i], K[i+1 mod h]).\n    unsigned long long mask = 0;\n    for (int base = 0; base < h; base += 32) {\n        const int i = base + lane;\n        bool vis = false;\n        if (i < h) {\n            const int n = (i + 1 == h) ? ~0ull : ((1ull << h) - 1ull);\n    const unsigned long long prevm = ((mask << 1) | (mask >> (h - 1))) & hmask;\n    const unsigned long long nextm = ((mask >> 1) | (mask << (h - 1))) & hmask;\n    const unsigned long long sm = mask & ~prevm;\n    const unsigned long long em = mask & ~nextm;\n    if (sm == 0ull || em == 0ull) { valid = false; return; }   // cannot happen for a convex polygon\n    const int start = __ffsll(static_cast<long long>(sm)) - 1;\n    const int end = __ffsll(static_cast<long long>(em)) - 1;\n    const int removed = (end - start + h) % h;      // vertices start+1 .. end\n    const int newh = h - removed + 1;\n    if (newh > H_MAX) { valid = false; return; }\n\n    // New sequence: K[start], p, K[end+1], ..., K[start-1].\n    double nx[2], ny[2];\n    long long nix[2], niy[2];\n    float nfx[2], nfy[2];\n#pragma unroll\n    for (int r = 0; r < 2; ++r) {\n        const int j = lane + r * 32;\n        if (j < newh) {\n            if (j == 1) {\n                nx[r] = x; ny[r] = y; nix[r] = ix; niy[r] = iy; nfx[r] = fx; nfy[r] = fy;\n            } else {\n                const int src = (j == 0) ? start : ((end + j - 1) % h);\n                nx[r] = H.hx[src]; ny[r] = H.hy[src]; nix[r] = H.hix[src]; niy[r] = H.hiy[src];\n                nfx[r] = H.hfx[src]; nfy[r] = H.hfy[src];\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    __syncwarp();\n#pragma unroll\n    for (int r = 0; r < 2; ++r) {\n        const int j = lane + r * 32;\n        if (j < newh) {\n            H.hx[j] = nx[r]; H.hy[j] = ny[r]; H.hix[j] = nix[r]; H.hiy[j] = niy[r];\n            H.hfx[j] = nfx[r]; H.hfy[j] = nfy[r];\n        }\n    }\n    __syncwarp();\n    h = newh;\n}\n\n// Lower bound (within rho) on s_c from the hull: max over hull vertices.\n__device__ __forceinline__ sbits_t hull_bound(const WarpShared& H, const int h,\n                                              const double cx, const double cy,\n                                              const float cfx, const float cfy, sbits_t sb) {\n    float mf = -INFINITY;\n#pragma unroll 4\n    for (int i = 0; i < h; ++i) {\n        const float f = dev_sqdist_f(H.hfx[i], H.hfy[i], cfx, cfy);\n        mf = (f > mf) ? f : mf;\n    }\n    const float thr = fmaf(mf, F32_REL, -F32_ABS);\n    for (int i = 0; i < h; ++i) {\n        if (dev_sqdist_f(H.hfx[i], H.hfy[i], cfx, cfy) >= thr) {\n            const sbits_t sm = __double_as_longlong(dev_sqdist(H.hx[i], H.hy[i], cx, cy));\n            sb = (sm > sb) ? sm : sb;\n        }\n    }\n    return sb;\n}\n\n// Exact s_c = max over all k members (starting from the lower bound sb).\n__device__ __forceinline__ sbits_t exact_s(const double* __restrict__ px, const double* __restrict__ py,\n                                           const int* __restrict__ m_idx, const float2* __restrict__ m_xy,\n                                           const int k, const double cx, const double cy,\n                                           const float cfx, const float cfy, sbits_t sb) {\n    float sf = bits_to_float_trunc(sb);\n    for (int m = 0; m < k; ++m) {\n        const float2 mc = m_xy[m];\n        if (dev_sqdist_f(mc.x, mc.y, cfx, cfy) >= fmaf(sf, F32_REL, -F32_ABS)) {\n            const int mi = m_idx[m];\n            const sbits_t sm = __double_as_longlong(dev_sqdist(px[mi], py[mi], cx, cy));\n            if (sm > sb) {\n                sb = sm;\n                sf = bits_to_float_trunc(sb);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    return sb;\n}\n\n// Warp-level inclusive prefix sum (int).\n__device__ __forceinline__ int warp_scan_int(int v, const int lane) {\n#pragma unroll\n    for (int off = 1; off < 32; off <<= 1) {\n        const int o = __shfl_up_sync(FULL_MASK, v, off);\n        if (lane >= off) v += o;\n    }\n    return v;\n}\n\n// Pick the bucket boundary from the 32-bucket histogram so that the\n// cumulative count stays <= target (at least bucket 0).  Returns the new\n// bound and the band total.\n__device__ __forceinline__ sbits_t pick_bound(WarpShared& S, const int lane, const sbits_t lo,\n                                              const sbits_t width, const sbits_t hi_cap,\n                                              const int target, int& total) {\n    __syncwarp();\n    const int cum = warp_scan_int(S.hist[lane], lane);\n    total = __shfl_sync(FULL_MASK, cum, 31);\n    const unsigned ok = __ballot_sync(FULL_MASK, cum <= target);\n    const int B = (ok == 0u) ? 0 : (31 - __clz(ok));\n    sbits_t bound = (B == 31) ? hi_cap : (lo + ((static_cast<sbits_t>(B + 1) * width) >> 5));\n    if (bound > hi_cap) bound = hi_cap;\n    __syncwarp();\n    return bound;\n}\n\n__device__ __forceinline__ void hist_add(WarpShared& S, const sbits_t v, const sbits_t lo,\n                                         const sbits_t width) {\n    sbits_t b = ((v - lo) << 5) / width;\n    b = (b > 31) ? 31 : b;\n    atomicAdd(&S.hist[static_cast<int>(b)], 1);\n}\n\n__global__ void __launch_bounds__(QT_BLOCK, QT_MIN_BLOCKS)\nqt_candidate_kernel(const double* __restrict__ px,\n                    const double* __restrict__ py,\n                    const float* __restrict__ pxf,\n                    const float* __restrict__ pyf,\n                    const long long* __restrict__ pix,     // fixed-point coordinates\n                    const long long* __restrict__ piy,\n                    const int* __restrict__ ux_idx,        // unclustered indices sorted by x\n                    const float* __restrict__ ux_f,        // their float x coordinates (ascending)\n                    const int U,\n                    const int* __restrict__ seeds,         // seeds to evaluate\n                    const int nseeds,\n                    const double s_crit,                   // keep iff s < s_crit\n                    const sbits_t tiny_bits,               // values below this are resolved    int* __restrict__ cardinality_out,     // per seed\n                    WarpScratch ws,\n                    const int cap_warp,                    // scratch entries per warp\n                    const int cap_members,                 // member slots per warp\n                    int* __restrict__ members_out)         // optional (nseeds == 1)\n{\n    __shared__ WarpShared s_warp[QT_WARPS];\n\n    const int lane = threadIdx.x & 31;\n    const int wib = threadIdx.x >> 5;\n    const int gw = blockIdx.x * QT_WARPS + wib;\n    WarpShared& S = s_warp[wib];\n    const size_t overflow after) -------\n#define A_IDX(e) ((e) < A_CAP ? S.a_idx[e] : ga_idx[(e) - A_CAP])\n#define A_S(e)   ((e) < A_CAP ? S.a_s[e] : ga_s[(e) - A_CAP])\n#define N_IDX(e) ((e) < N_CAP ? S.n_idx[e] : gn_idx[(e) - N_CAP])\n#define N_S(e)   ((e) < N_CAP ? All start far-dormant with the\n        // exact distance to the seed as bound.\n        const int lo = dev_lower_bound(ux_f, U, sxf - thr_slab);\n        const int hi = dev_lower_bound(ux_f, U, sxf + thr_slab);\n        int cnt_a = 0, cnt_n = 0, cnt_f = 0;            // far-dormant candidates have bound > D_far\n        sbits_t delta = DELTA_INIT;\n        sbits_t delta_far = DELTA_INIT << 2;\n        sbits_t ls = SBITS_INF;        // running local arg-min over active candidates\n        int li = INT_MAX;\n        bool flag = false;\n        int best = seed;               // member to add\n\n        for (;;) {\n            // ---- add member `best` ----------------------------------------\n            const double mx = px[best];\n            const double my = py[best];\n            const float mxf = pxf[best];\n            const float myf = pyf[best];\n            const long long mix = pix[best];\n            const long long miy = piy[best];\n            if (lane == 0) {\n                m_idx[k] = best;\n                m_xy[k] = make_float2(mxf, myf);\n                if (members_out != nullptr) members_out[k] = best;\n            }\n            hull_insert(S, h, hull_valid, lane, mx, my, mix, miy, mxf, myf);\n            ++k;\n            __syncwarp(); FP64 compares are 1/64 rate on RTX 3090, so the integer domain mattered.\n- Per seed: one warp; active set + near/far dormant tiers in shared memory (warp-level lists with ballot compaction); dormant bounds are re-evaluated from the members' convex hull (exact fixed-point orientation predicates, 128-bit products). Lazy catch-up over missed members was a dead end (still O(candidates x steps)).\n- Branch and bound: seeds sorted by upper bound (points within threshold), per-device atomic best key (card<<32 | INT_MAX-seed), abort when members + remaining (after a periodic prune pass) or the Jung-window occupancy-grid bound cannot win. Aborted tasks still dominate steps (~75%): bounds fire late.\n- Per-step latency chain is ~9-10K cycles (insert ~1.5K, update ~2.7K, argmin ~1K, activation ~5K avg); the regen launch was removed by capturing the winner's member list under a device lock.\n- Timings on 4x3090: n=1000 17-19 ms (orig 7 s), n=3000 ~38 ms (orig 478 s), n=50000 ~0.9 s.\n- A warp-collective inside a lane-divergent branch deadlocks silently (lanes stuck at different barriers); cuda-gdb `info cuda lanes` plus host-mapped debug memory found it.\n\n**Why:** avoids repeating ~20 profiling/rewrite cycles if the kernel is revisited.\n**How to apply:** further gains need earlier aborts (tighter cardinality bounds) or a shorter per-step chain, not more occupancy tuning (sweeps of active target / prune period / launch bounds were all within noise).
